title: The Wolf Problem
description: Wolves have got bold enough to walk the logging roads in daylight. One took Aldous Fenn by the leg two days back, and he will not go out with the felling crews again. Tharin wants them thinned.

objectives.description: Kill wolves prowling the logging roads (0/5)

notes: Threat: a named woodsman (Aldous Fenn, invented for this quest only, prose colour) mauled and unwilling to return to work; the roads unsafe before the winter cut. Giver motive: third of Tharin's four trust tests, the combat one, before he trusts the player with the Keepers' letter (see the_letter.json / id keepers_letter_delivery). Distinct from logging_troubles (dire wolves, western camp, two woodsmen already dead, a den to clear) and from Thornfield's eastern_wolves / wolf_pack_menace - this is ordinary wolves on the open road, about trust, not a hunt.
